trust_decision.summary: ValidityStore::has_transaction decides whether a raw tx hash was already included 'within the validity window' (replay protection) using a lookback of only validity_window_blocks, while Transaction::is_valid_at accepts a tx for validity_window_blocks + blocks_per_batch blocks; a tx with a future validity_start_height drops out of the store while still valid and can be re-included.

landing_point.why: Summary names the validity store and an off-by-one; has_transaction's window computation is the only window arithmetic in that file and is exactly what the fix changes.

fix_sites.entry_point: Blockchain::push (micro block import, push.rs:596 via Blockchain::contains_tx_in_validity_window wrappers.rs:197-202) and Mempool transaction admission (mempool/src/verify.rs:55)
fix_sites.module_kind: core storage index (validity store) in the blockchain crate

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The published fix is one source hunk; history_store_index.rs:385-391, history_store_proxy.rs:238-248 and merged_history_store.rs:170-175 only delegate to the same has_transaction and need no change.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the O8 equivocation route: equivocation proofs are a different object (slashing evidence, not transactions) with their own reporting window, and the advisory talks only about transaction validity, so a solver can argue the epoch-long proof window is a separate feature.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Transaction validity semantics (accept a tx from validity_start_height - blocks_per_batch to validity_start_height + window - 1) must stay unchanged; the tempting alternative of narrowing is_valid_at instead of widening the lookback would reject protocol-valid transactions/blocks (consensus split). Pruning must also keep enough blocks for the new lookback (already validity_window_blocks + blocks_per_batch).

O6_input_shapes: transaction whose validity_start_height is ahead of its inclusion block (up to +blocks_per_batch) - the only shape that exposes the gap
any HistoricTransaction hash in the store (equivocation event hashes share the same has_transaction lookback, history_store.rs:807-811)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Equivocation-proof replay check uses the same store/lookback (W+B = 7260 blocks after fix) while proofs stay valid for blocks_per_epoch (43200) after the offense, so an already-included proof can be re-included later and re-jail the validator.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Equivocation proofs are slashing evidence, not transactions; the advisory is about the transaction validity window.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same crate (blockchain/src/blockchain/verify.rs, blockchain/src/history/history_store.rs:802-815) plus validity rule in another package (primitives/block/src/equivocation_proof.rs:126-129, primitives/src/policy.rs:503-505)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Pruning keeps only transaction_validity_window_blocks, so the widened lookback in has_transaction looks at rows that were already deleted.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer mirroring the original check constant into the prune routine is natural; the check never calls the pruner (how-type producer sibling).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Light/validity-window sync starts at macro_head - transaction_validity_window_blocks without the extra batch, leaving freshly synced nodes with a short store.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same window subtraction already exists there; only the round-back to the previous election block hides the gap today.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: tree_from_chunks fills the validity store from synced chunks; a variant that filters chunks by block_number > head - window would drop still-valid hashes.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Sync paths commonly trim to 'the window' to save space, and this producer is far from the check.

O9_family: off-by-one in replay-protection window (CWE-193 leading to CWE-294 replay)

O10_build.project_tests: blockchain/src/history/history_store.rs and history_store_index.rs unit tests (transaction_in_validity_window_works), merged_history_store.rs:449, primitives/transaction/tests/validity.rs; volatile MDBX, no network

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Change '>' to '>=' (a literal off-by-one) or subtract 1 from the lookback instead of adding blocks_per_batch, missing that validity starts blocks_per_batch before validity_start_height.
